state.task:
Question-answering task over a company handbook.

The handbook is in /task/fixtures/handbook/ (40 documents, HB-01.md to HB-40.md). Each document
has a header line (version, status, effective dates, what it supersedes) and numbered sections;
each section is a passage, cited as "HB-07 §2". Documents can have superseded versions, and
memos can add group exceptions and carve-outs. Use the rule that applies to the situation and
date in the question.

Tools (in your code):
  import sys; sys.path.insert(0, "/task/fixtures")
  from handbook_tools import search, show
  search("lodging limit Geneva", k=5)   # up to k (at most 8) ranked passages, with ids
  show(["HB-07 §2", "HB-12 §3"])        # the named passages in full
Every search result is also saved under /task/workspace/search-results/ (the path is printed in
the result header). You may also read the documents directly.

Questions:
- Q1: What mileage rate applied to a business trip in a private petrol car on 2026-03-15? (answer in cents per km)
- Q2: What is the purchase approval threshold for a purchase by the facilities department today? (answer in EUR)
- Q3: What is the home-office equipment allowance for an employee with a medical accessibility plan who works 16 hours a week today? (answer in EUR)
- Q4: What is the daily meal allowance for an intern on a client-site day in Paris today? (answer in EUR per day)
- Q5: What is the relocation lump sum for a regular employee relocating at the company's request today (2026-10-13)? (answer in EUR)
- Q6: What is the nightly lodging limit for a standard business trip whose stay includes a Saturday night today? (answer in EUR per night)

Finish with {"action": "final", "answer": {"answers": [{"question": "Q1", "value": "...",
"citations": ["HB-07 §2", ...]}, ...]}}. Give one entry per question. The value must be the
exact amount; citations must include every passage needed to support it (for example the
rule and any exception or carve-out that applies), not just one passage.
state.step_intent: Find the mileage rate that applies to: What mileage rate applied to a business trip in a private petrol car on 2026-03-15?

passages.source: HB-30 §1 | Policy FAQ — Current mileage rate | version: 7 · status: current · effective: 2026-01-15
passages.text: Q: What is the current standard mileage rate? A: 31 cents per km, as set in HB-34 §2 (effective 2026-04-01). Group exceptions are listed in HB-07.

passages.source: HB-07 §2 | Memo: mileage rate exceptions — Exception for electric vehicles | version: 1 · status: current · effective: 2025-07-01
passages.text: For electric vehicles, the mileage rate is 41 cents per km instead of the standard amount. Line managers check each claim for plausibility before it is released for payment. Repeated late or incomplete claims may be escalated to the head of the department. Amounts are stated in euros; conversions use the published rate on the day of payment.

passages.source: HB-07 §1 | Memo: mileage rate exceptions — Purpose | version: 1 · status: current · effective: 2025-07-01
passages.text: This memo lists group exceptions to the mileage rate in HB-34. Where a local agreement sets stricter rules, the stricter rule applies for that location. Managers may reject claims that are not supported by the documentation described here. Supporting records are kept for seven years in line with the retention schedule.

passages.source: HB-07 §3 | Memo: mileage rate exceptions — Carve-out | version: 1 · status: current · effective: 2025-07-01
passages.text: The exception above does not apply to electric rental cars; they follow the standard mileage rate in HB-34 §2. Questions about this section go to the policy owner named in the document header. Repeated late or incomplete claims may be escalated to the head of the department. Receipts must be attached for every item claimed; photographs of paper receipts are accepted.

passages.source: HB-09 §1 | Travel policy: private car use — Scope | version: 2 · status: superseded · effective: 2025-07-01 to the day before 2026-04-01 · superseded by: HB-34
passages.text: This version set the mileage rate for all employees. Questions about this section go to the policy owner named in the document header. Amounts are stated in euros; conversions use the published rate on the day of payment. Repeated late or incomplete claims may be escalated to the head of the department.
